listen_address.description: IP address the XRDP server listens on (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all, or 127.0.0.1 for localhost-only).

rdp_port.description: TCP port used for RDP connections.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for RDP sessions (requires valid keys in /etc/xrdp/rsakeys.txt).

tls_level.description: TLS encryption strength: low (RC4), medium (3DES), high (AES). Only used if TLS is enabled.

disable_local_auth.description: Set to true to disable local username/password authentication (forces PAM-only login).

use_pam.description: Use PAM for authentication (required for most Linux login integrations like LDAP, Kerberos).

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent RDP sessions allowed.

session_timeout.description: Idle session timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout).

log_path.description: Absolute path to the main XRDP log file.

modules.description: Map of RDP modules (channels) to enable. Keys are identifiers (e.g., 'Xvnc', 'Xorg'), values describe module behavior.

name.description: Human-readable module name (e.g., 'Xvnc'). Defaults to the key if omitted.

value.description: Module-specific configuration (e.g., VNC port for Xvnc, X server args).

group_rules.description: Map of Unix group names → allowed RDP session types. Users in the group may launch sessions of the listed types.

items.description: Comma-separated list of allowed session types (e.g., 'Xvnc,Xorg').
